origins.name: Sect Orphan
origins.blurb: Raised on the sect's rice and its rules. You own nothing but a place in the dormitory.
origins.condition: Fed, housed and owed: the sect expects repayment.

origins.name: Merchant's Child
origins.blurb: Ledgers, weights and the smell of salt. You arrive with coin and very little patience.
origins.condition: Rich enough to buy your first year, not your second.

origins.name: Hunter's Child
origins.blurb: You grew up reading tracks instead of manuals, and the wilds never frightened you.
origins.condition: Your body is tempered; your meridians are not.

origins.name: Fallen Clan Heir
origins.blurb: Your family name used to open doors. Now it closes them.
origins.condition: Proud, trained, and without a single spirit stone.
